resolution: Fixed the multi-Outliner Merge Parts → Merge Faces corruption at both native boundaries. Structural part/group changes now invalidate stale indexed ownership, every indexed cache clone validates resident groups, parts, and materials before reuse, range normalization refuses impossible stale owners, and Merge Faces rejects bent/non-coplanar selections before generating a fan. Added focused regressions for the exact ownership chain and bent-face geometry; 47 mesh-edit, 43 model-paint, and 14 mesh-journal tests pass, and the ReleaseFast editor build succeeds.
